name: translations
description: Translations for the integreat frontend projects

scripts.export: yarn manage export src/translations integreat-csv && ./tools/csv-to-ods integreat-csv translations-ods && rm -rf integreat-csv
scripts.export:malte: yarn manage export src/override-translations/malte malte-csv && ./tools/csv-to-ods malte-csv malte-ods && rm -rf malte-csv
scripts.export:aschaffenburg: yarn manage export src/override-translations/aschaffenburg aschaffenburg-csv && ./tools/csv-to-ods aschaffenburg-csv aschaffenburg-ods && rm -rf aschaffenburg-csv
scripts.export:obdach: yarn manage export src/override-translations/obdach obdach-csv && ./tools/csv-to-ods obdach-csv obdach-ods && rm -rf obdach-csv
scripts.import: ./tools/ods-to-csv translations-ods integreat-csv && yarn manage import integreat-csv src/translations && rm -rf integreat-csv
scripts.import:malte: ./tools/ods-to-csv malte-ods malte-csv && yarn manage import malte-csv src/override-translations/malte && rm -rf malte-csv
scripts.import:aschaffenburg: ./tools/ods-to-csv aschaffenburg-ods aschaffenburg-csv && yarn manage import aschaffenburg-csv src/override-translations/aschaffenburg && rm -rf aschaffenburg-csv
scripts.import:obdach: ./tools/ods-to-csv obdach-ods obdach-csv && yarn manage import obdach-csv src/override-translations/obdach && rm -rf obdach-csv
